evidence.text: Kebab Patrol is an awesome new addition to the neighborhood. Conveniently parked on 14th Street near Harrison, this food truck is slinging incredibly flavorful Turkish kebabs wrapped in wonderful, fresh homemade lavaş bread.The food is …
Kebab patrol is amazing! They were super nice, large portions, and great food. Putting this place on my weekly rotation.
Kebab Patrol. Doner kebab restaurant. Mission District. 1750 Harrison St, San Francisco, CA 94103
